Customer Support

How Can We Help?

Get instant answers in the chat, or send your issue straight to our team on WhatsApp.

How much is delivery, and how fast?

Delivery is free above ₹3,000, otherwise ₹150. Orders placed before 2 PM can go out the same day. We are based in Vijayawada, so please ask us about areas outside the city.

How do I pay?

You can pay on delivery or by UPI at the door.

How do I order a custom cake?

Use the Atelier Custom builder on this page to pick size, flavour, finish and a message. For a special design or a fixed date, message us on WhatsApp.

I have an allergy. What should I do?

Our cakes and pastries may contain nuts, dairy, gluten and eggs. Please check the exact ingredients with our team before you order.

Something is wrong with my order

We are sorry about that. Send us your order number (it looks like BB12345) and what went wrong using the form, and our team will help.

Where is my order?

Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and we will update you.
